language.name: English
settings.languageHint: System follows the computer's language. Applies to every workspace.
fatal.title: BigMouth hit an error it could not recover from
fatal.detail: Your posts are on disk and unaffected. Restart the app; the session log has the details.
dialog.refusedMetadata.explanation: A metadata field shows a value BigMouth refused, such as a slug another post uses, so the post keeps its last accepted value. The field says why.
dialog.unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
dialog.unsavedChanges.message: Some edits could not be saved.
dialog.unsavedChanges.detail: BigMouth could not write your latest changes to disk. Quit anyway and lose them, or cancel and copy your text somewhere safe? The editor shows why each post could not be saved.
dialog.unsavedChanges.detailWithMetadata: BigMouth could not write your latest changes to disk. {refused} Quit anyway and lose them, or cancel and copy your text somewhere safe? The editor shows why each post could not be saved.
dialog.unsavedMetadata.title: Unsaved metadata
dialog.unsavedMetadata.message: A metadata value was not saved.
dialog.unsavedMetadata.quitDetail: {refused} Quit anyway and lose it, or cancel and fix the field?
dialog.unsavedMetadata.closeDetail: {refused} Close anyway and lose it, or cancel and fix the field?
dialog.startupFailure.title: BigMouth could not start
dialog.startupFailure.message: BigMouth could not finish opening its settings and workspace.
dialog.startupFailure.detail: No posts or workspace documents were changed. Check the session log, then start BigMouth again.
